hero.title: Spaces that speak in quiet luxury.
hero.subtitle: Serviced apartments for unforgettable stays, interiors designed around you, and furniture made to last, all under one name.
hero.posterAlt: A modern two-storey home glowing with warm interior light at dusk

intro.title: Three disciplines. One uncompromising standard.
intro.body: From the apartment you check into, to the room you come home to, to the office your team works in, BlackPro Homes brings the same eye for detail to every space we touch.

services.title: Short-let Apartments
services.body: Fully serviced luxury apartments across Lagos' most sought-after addresses, for a night, a week or a season.
services.alt: Dark, elegant bedroom with a tufted bed and city views

services.title: Interior Design
services.body: Residential and commercial interiors, from a single consultation to full project management and handover.
services.alt: Warm, styled living room with a grey sofa and timber coffee table

services.title: Furniture & Office
services.body: Statement home furniture, custom-made pieces and complete office fit-outs, sourced and installed by our team.
services.alt: Bright open-plan office with dining tables and pendant lights

shortlets.title: Stay at Lagos' most coveted addresses.
shortlets.body: Serviced apartments with hotel-grade linens, reliable power and attentive guest support.

portfolio.title: Transformations, not just makeovers.
portfolio.body: Drag the slider to see how our team reimagines a space, from the first sketch to the final cushion.

furniture.title: Pieces chosen to be lived with.
furniture.body: Living, bedroom, dining and office furniture, plus custom pieces made to your measurements.

fitOut.title: Office fit-outs that work as hard as you do.
fitOut.body: Workstations, executive suites, meeting rooms and breakout spaces, planned, supplied and installed end to end.
fitOut.alt: Modern open-plan office with long tables and black pendant lights

points.title: One team, end to end
points.body: Design, furniture supply and installation handled in-house, so nothing gets lost between contractors.

points.title: Hotel-grade service
points.body: Professionally cleaned, fully stocked apartments with responsive guest support throughout your stay.

points.title: Transparent pricing
points.body: Clear quotes in naira with no surprise extras, agreed before any work begins.

points.title: Built for Lagos
points.body: Power backup, security and finishes chosen to perform in the city's climate and pace.
